description: Structured financials for one company-year, as printed in the report.

fiscal_year_label.description: Fiscal year exactly as printed, e.g. '2023-24' or 'FY2024'.
fiscal_year_label.title: Fiscal Year Label

period_end_date.description: Closing date of the reporting period, usually 31 March.
period_end_date.title: Period End Date

basis.description: Which set of statements these figures come from. Use CONSOLIDATED whenever the report contains consolidated statements.
basis.title: Basis

reporting_unit.description: The unit the statements are denominated in, from the header line such as '(Rs. in crore)' or '(Amount in Rs. lakhs)'. Applies to all monetary fields, never to per-share figures.
reporting_unit.title: Reporting Unit

revenue.description: Revenue from Operations. NOT Total Income — Total Income adds other income and is reported separately below.
revenue.title: Revenue

total_income.description: Total Income (revenue from operations plus other income).
total_income.title: Total Income

ebitda.description: Only if the report states EBITDA or 'Operating Profit' explicitly. Leave null rather than deriving it.
ebitda.title: Ebitda

tax_expense.description: Total tax expense: current plus deferred.
tax_expense.title: Tax Expense

pat.description: Profit After Tax for the year. Where the report splits profit attributable to owners versus non-controlling interests, use profit attributable to owners of the parent.
pat.title: Pat

eps_basic.description: Basic earnings per share, in rupees per share.
eps_basic.title: Eps Basic

total_debt.description: Interest-bearing borrowings, current plus non-current. Excludes trade payables and other non-debt liabilities.
total_debt.title: Total Debt

cash.description: Cash and cash equivalents, plus bank balances treated as such.
cash.title: Cash

contingent_liabilities.description: Total contingent liabilities from the notes.
contingent_liabilities.title: Contingent Liabilities

ocf.description: Net cash generated from operating activities.
ocf.title: Ocf

capex.description: Purchase of property, plant and equipment plus intangibles, as a POSITIVE magnitude even though the cash flow statement shows it as an outflow in brackets.
capex.title: Capex

fcf.description: Only if the report states free cash flow. Otherwise null.
fcf.title: Fcf

auditor_opinion.description: Opinion type in the Independent Auditor's Report.
auditor_opinion.title: Auditor Opinion

auditor_remarks.description: Verbatim basis for any qualification, adverse opinion or disclaimer. Null when the opinion is unmodified.
auditor_remarks.title: Auditor Remarks

extraction_notes.description: Anything ambiguous: figures restated, a line item found under an unusual name, standalone used because consolidated was absent, a value that could not be located. Null if the extraction was clean.
extraction_notes.title: Extraction Notes

title: AnnualReportExtraction
